source.name: Senitron RFID Inventory Management for Dynamics 365 and Business Central

mapping.summary: RFID handheld stock counting, transfers and receiving synced with Business Central
claims: Handheld reader reads hundreds of tags per second without line of sight
Counts 10,000 to 20,000 items in 15 to 30 minutes
Downloads BC catalog and quantities, compares counts and sends corrections back
Transfer orders scanned out and received with RFID slips and partial receipts
Purchase order receiving by scan with over, short and unexpected exceptions
RFID item locator with store map
Replenishment alerts and exit alerts for loss prevention
Fixed readers and RFID tunnels for hands-free tracking and carton audits
Uses standard Zebra hardware with remote setup in 2 to 4 hours
Month-to-month pricing with a 30-day money-back guarantee
Also integrates NetSuite, Shopify, Lightspeed and others plus an open API
